hero.title: How can we help you?
hero.description: Find answers to common questions about your Banko account, cards, and personal details.

cards.a1: Once you receive your physical card, open the Banko app, go to Cards, select your new card, and follow the activation instructions. Make sure your card details are correct before completing the process.
cards.q2: How do I create a virtual card?
cards.a2: Open the Cards section in your Banko app and select Create Virtual Card. Follow the instructions to generate your card. Once created, you can view its details and use it for online payments.
cards.q3: How to order an extra card?
cards.a3: Go to the Cards section and check the available card options. Select the additional card you want and follow the ordering instructions. Contact our support team if you need assistance.
cards.q4: My card will expire soon. What to do?
cards.a4: You should arrange a replacement before your current card expires. Check the Cards section for replacement options and follow the instructions. If you haven't received your replacement, contact our support team.
cards.q5: How do I freeze my card?
cards.a5: Open the Banko app, navigate to Cards, select the card you want to freeze, and choose the Freeze Card option. This temporarily prevents the card from being used. You can manage its status from the same section.

account.q1: How do I verify my account?
account.a1: Go to your account settings and select Verify Account. Follow the instructions to submit the required identification documents. Make sure your information is accurate and your documents are clearly visible.
account.a2: Visit the Account or Plans section in your Banko app to explore available plans. Select your preferred plan and follow the instructions to complete the upgrade.
account.a3: Available account options depend on the services offered by your Banko plan. Check your account settings for available options or contact our support team for further information.
account.q4: How do I cancel my account?
account.a4: If you want to stop using your Banko account, contact our support team to request account cancellation. They can guide you through the required steps and explain anything you need to complete beforehand.

personalDetails.q1: How do I change my account address?
personalDetails.a1: Open your profile settings and navigate to Personal Details. Select your address information, update the required fields, and save your changes. You may be asked to provide supporting documentation.
personalDetails.a2: To permanently close your Banko account, contact our support team. Before requesting closure, make sure you review your remaining balance and any pending transactions. Our team will guide you through the process.
personalDetails.q3: Where do I find my tax ID?
personalDetails.a3: Check your Personal Details or Account Documents section for your registered tax information. If your tax ID isn't displayed, contact our support team for assistance.
personalDetails.q4: How can I download my bank documents?
personalDetails.a4: Open your Banko app and navigate to Documents or Statements. Select the document you need and choose Download to save it to your device.

toc.sec1: Separate Your Business and Personal Finances
toc.sec5: Choose Tools That Grow With Your Business

content.introP1: Starting a business is exciting, but managing its finances can quickly become complicated. Between incoming payments, daily expenses, and planning for future growth, keeping everything organized is essential.
content.introP2: Having a clear view of your business finances helps you make better decisions and spend more time focusing on what matters: building your business.
content.introP3: Banko helps simplify everyday financial management by bringing payment management and financial organization into one experience.
content.sec1Title: 01. Separate Your Business and Personal Finances
content.sec1P1: One of the first steps when starting a business is keeping personal and business finances separate.
content.sec1P2: Mixing the two makes it harder to understand how your business is performing and where your money is going.
content.sec1Bullet1: Keeping business income separate from personal income.
content.sec1Outro: A clear separation makes financial organization easier as your business grows.
content.sec2P1: Payments are part of almost every business operation. You might receive money from customers, pay suppliers, or handle recurring business expenses.
content.sec2P2: Without a consistent process, it becomes easy to lose track of transactions.
content.sec2Bullet1: Keep records of incoming and outgoing payments.
content.sec2Bullet3: Organize payment information so it is easy to find.
content.sec2Bullet4: Make sure important payments are not overlooked.
content.sec2Outro: Banko helps you manage payments and keep your everyday financial activity organized.
content.sec3P1: Revenue alone does not tell you everything about your business's financial health.
content.sec3P2: You also need to understand when money comes in, when expenses are due, and how much money remains available.
content.sec3Outro: Reviewing these numbers regularly helps you avoid unnecessary surprises and plan ahead.
content.sec4P1: Good financial management does not require complicated processes.
content.sec4Habits: A few consistent habits can make a significant difference:
content.sec4Bullet1: Review your business finances every week.
content.sec4Bullet3: Check expenses before making new commitments.
content.sec4Bullet4: Set aside money for upcoming obligations.
content.sec4Bullet5: Review your financial goals every month.
content.sec4Outro: The important thing is consistency. Small habits make financial decisions easier over time.
content.sec5Title: 05. Choose Tools That Grow With Your Business
content.sec5P1: Your financial needs will change as your startup develops.
content.sec5P2: What works when you are working alone might not be enough when you start handling more customers, payments, and expenses.
content.sec5P3: Choose financial tools that make everyday tasks easier rather than adding unnecessary complexity.
content.sec5Outro: Banko is designed to help you manage payments and organize your finances, giving you a simpler way to handle everyday banking as you focus on growing your startup.
content.conclusionP1: Starting a business means making hundreds of decisions, and managing money is one of the most important.
content.conclusionP2: Keep your finances organized, understand your cash flow, build consistent financial habits, and choose tools that simplify your daily operations.
content.conclusionP3: You do not need a complicated financial system to get started. You need a clear process and the right tools to support it.
content.conclusionP4: Banko helps keep your everyday banking simpler, so you can focus on what comes next for your business.
